concerns.text: Task T003 (linting/formatting) is marked `[P]` but depends on the packages installed by T001.2 (`requirements.txt`). Running T003 before T001.2 can cause lint/format checks to fail, violating the producer‑before‑consumer rule.

Task T020 (extreme compliance case flag) modifies the behavior of T009 but is scheduled after T009. The flag will never be applied unless T009 is re‑executed, creating a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.

Task T001.1 creates the full project directory tree, including `data/{raw,processed,compliance}`. Task T004 also creates the same data sub‑folders. Both are marked `[P]` but share the same filesystem locations, making them unsafe for parallel execution.

Task T001.2 installs the scientific stack via `requirements.txt`. Subsequent tasks (e.g., T003 linting, any code execution) rely on those packages. Marking T001.2 as `[P]` suggests it can run in parallel with dependent tasks, which is unsafe.

Task T004 creates `data/raw/`, `data/processed/`, `data/compliance/`. Since T001.1 already creates these directories, running T004 in parallel can cause race conditions. The `[P]` tag is therefore inaccurate.
